rules.description: Name and address of the manufacturer (or packer/importer if applicable) must be declared.
rules.error_message: Manufacturer name is missing from the label.

rules.description: Complete address of the manufacturer must be declared (street, city/state or PIN code).
rules.error_message: Manufacturer address is missing or does not contain a valid 6-digit PIN code.

rules.description: Common or generic name of the commodity must be declared.
rules.error_message: Common or generic name of the commodity is missing.

rules.description: Net quantity of the commodity (by weight/measure/number) must be declared.
rules.error_message: Net quantity is missing from the label.

rules.description: Unit used must follow SI convention.
rules.error_message: Net quantity unit does not follow the required SI convention for its magnitude.

rules.description: Counting terms like dozen, score, gross or great gross must not be used.
rules.error_message: Net quantity declaration uses a prohibited counting unit.

rules.description: Quantity declaration must not contain exaggerated or misleading qualifiers.
rules.error_message: Net quantity declaration contains a misleading qualifier.

rules.description: Month and year of manufacture or pre-packing must be declared.
rules.error_message: Month and year of manufacture is missing or not in a recognizable format.

rules.description: Retail sale price must be declared.
rules.error_message: MRP is missing from the label.

rules.description: MRP must be printed in the required format including taxes wording.
rules.error_message: MRP is present but not declared in the required format.

rules.description: Consumer care details should be declared.
rules.error_message: Consumer care details are missing from the label.

rules.description: Declarations must be in Hindi or English.
rules.error_message: Mandatory declarations are not present in Hindi or English.

rules.description: Items sold by number should use the symbol N or U.
rules.error_message: Items sold by number should use unit symbol N or U.

rules.description: Declaration must be legible and prominent.
rules.error_message: Text legibility is questionable and needs manual review.
